topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: FOUND an old bear, they say. Soft and worn, with button eyes that’ve seen better days. It brings back memories, like the smell of rain on dry soil, or the quiet of the church after a long day’s toil. That bear, it’s a piece of a life from long ago, a time when worries were as light as the clouds drifting across the sky. Now, it’s just a shadow, a reminder of what’s been left behind. The years lay heavy, like the autumn leaves that blanket the fields. It’s hard to think of the boy who once held that bear tightly, now a man, with so much weight on his shoulders.
